author: Retro Game Corps
description:
For years, the Steam Deck was the easiest handheld PC to recommend, but with its recent price hike, I think the ROG Xbox Ally (running official SteamOS) has now taken that crown. This video will show you how easy it is to run SteamOS on it, and what sort of PC gaming and emulation you can expect.

Xbox Ally: https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/GbWE4r
USB drive: https://link.amazon/A02ngtgQ5

Download SteamOS: https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/65B4-2AA3-5F37-4227
